Container.Name: HomeOS
Container.Overview: HomeOS is a self-hosted home-lab dashboard for infrastructure, network and media services, with a personal workspace for files, notes and everyday tasks. Monitor Unraid and Proxmox, connect network and media services, and organise your home lab from one dashboard. New installations start in Demo Mode; after first-run administrator setup, switch to Live Mode in Settings to connect your services. Keep this container on a trusted LAN or VPN and complete the one-time setup-token flow shown in the container log.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the HomeOS web interface. Leave at 3080 unless another service already uses that port.

Config.Name: HomeOS configuration
Config.Description: Persistent database, encryption key and setup-token storage. HomeOS creates this folder and sets its ownership to PUID:PGID automatically.

Config.Name: HomeOS shared files
Config.Description: Persistent shared library for files, notes, wiki pages and music. HomeOS creates this folder and sets its ownership to PUID:PGID automatically.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: IANA time zone for dates and scheduled activity. Change this to your local zone, for example Europe/London or America/New_York.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the HomeOS appdata folders. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the HomeOS appdata folders. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for HomeOS. Secrets such as the database and encryption key always stay private.

Config.Name: HomeOS shared files storage path
Config.Description: Container path for the shared files library. Keep this matched to the HomeOS shared files mapping.

Config.Name: Initial Demo Mode
Config.Description: Initial mode for a new HomeOS database. Keep true to explore sample data; switch to Live Mode later in Settings. Does not reset an existing database's saved mode.

Config.Name: Require HTTPS
Config.Description: Set true only after an HTTPS reverse proxy is working; otherwise protected requests will be rejected.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxies
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated IP addresses or CIDRs of reverse proxies allowed to supply forwarded headers. Leave empty when using HomeOS directly.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Application log detail: DEBUG, INFO, WARN or ERROR.
